propositions: Per-test git rev-parse HEAD calls execute 26k times across full suite and consume ~207 runner-seconds / ~75s projected macOS wall-time
Current _no_repo_commits guard must detect HEAD moves, name offending tests, preserve allow_repo_writes escape, and retain session dirty-tree backstop
In-process HEAD fingerprint after one-time worktree discovery can replace two per-test Git processes but requires safe handling of symbolic refs, packed refs, detached HEAD, and linked worktrees

OSS consensus (4/4 projects: pytest, pip, Poetry, pre-commit) rejects per-test source-checkout VCS subprocesses but offers no fidelity-preserving primitive matching rebar's stricter checkout-attribution contract
Candidate implementations (Git library dependency, hand-parsing ref formats, or removing attribution guard) each violate session constraints or approval thresholds and remain unapproved
